name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno-based precious metals company focused on gold exploration and royalty creation in Nevada and Idaho. The company holds multiple mineral property interests including the Lazy Claims, Loman, and Agai-Pah properties in Mineral County, Nevada, and the Swales Property in Elko County, Nevada. Nevada Canyon Gold operates as an early-stage explorer and royalty company with a diversified model that combines direct exploration with royalty acquisition.
